template.p: From this screen you'll have an overview of the essential stuff happening in your payroll.
Warnings will direct you to faulty records, you can choose to add new one from Here
Batches contains the payslips and their states
Employer cost will show you the trend of your global amount to pay for your workforce every month
Employer Trends will show you, based on running contracts, your headcount
And in this block? Notes! You can create as many as you want to keep track of all important stuff.
